stack.qualification: Nominal dimension chain only. Measure the usable female thread depth and actual PCB, washer and stud dimensions. Confirm at least 3.0 mm engagement in upper joints, no bottoming and full lower nut engagement. Both metal washer faces must contact GND only.

sources.contact_rating_scope: Male exact-SKU rating unqualified; no summed ampacity claim.

interboard.connection: Direct vertical1:1 through isolated screen holes; no ribbon cable or half-twist
interboard.assembly_current_limit: 0.5A source design bound, not bench qualification. Each FILTER_OUT contact must withstand it; parallel pins do not multiply the rated assembly current. INA SYS return1mA maximum. Generic male current/contact resistance requires actual qualification.
interboard.route: Pins pass through twelve separate NPTH2.0mm apertures. Copper cleared at least0.50mm from drill and across array.
interboard.orientation_warning: Generic unkeyed pair: use board pin1 marks. LOGIC is flippedX180 and uses a mirrored female footprint; do not replace with an ordinary unmirrored footprint.
interboard.SYS_3V3_return: Pin7 is downstream J11 SYS_3V3 returned from LOGIC only to U12.5 and C63.1; it does not feed the converter or bypass J11.
interboard.additional_signals: Pin10 SDA and12 SCL use existing M1.15/M1.16; 7bit INA address0x40.
